thread:
kai: Heads-up — seeing repeated flip-flop for tenant routing between eu-west1 and us-east1 during the last deploy. cost penalties keep oscillating and we get cold-fallbacks. anyone seen this?
sarah: yep spotted it about 40m ago after the cost-window tweak. graph shows route weight crossing back and forth ~6x.
devin: can you share the metric link and the policy that was used? my hunch: smoothing window is too short so the slope reacts to transient bursts.
kai: https://grafana.company/tenant-123/routing — look at route_weight_eu vs route_weight_us. policy snippet used:```
policy {
  prefer: region("eu-west1") if latency < 120ms
  penalty: cost_slope(0.8, window=5m)
}
```
maria: 5m window + slope=0.8 is pretty aggressive for multiregion traffic. when traffic skews the cost for a few minutes the penalty overshoots then quickly compensates. that causes the thrash.
devin: agree. short term mitigation: increase window or add a clamp on penalty so score change < 0.35 per recalculation.
sarah: i can flip a flag for the tenant to bump window -> 10m and clamp penalty to 0.35. low-risk and reversible. /ops flag set routing.tenant.123.cost_window=10m; /ops flag set routing.tenant.123.max_penalty=0.35 :thumbsup:
kai: that should help. longer term we should add explicit hysteresis in the policy engine: a stability_boost that decays over N minutes so we don't react to transient spikes. also need a clean interface for tenant overrides vs global defaults.
maria: sketch of stability_boost idea: adjusted_score = base_score - min(cost_penalty, clamp) * (1 - stability_boost(t)) where stability_boost(t) ramps from 0->0.6 over 5m after a route change. keeps recent winners sticky.
devin: sounds good. this implies modifying eval contract: policy evaluation needs to return both score and change_epoch so the runtime can apply time-based decay. that's a breaking change for plugins. we should make it opt-in behind feature flag and provide a shim that returns change_epoch=now for old plugins.
sarah: propose we do quick mitigation now (i'll push flags), then RFC for: 1) policy-eval extension (score + change_epoch), 2) DSL stable_boost primitive, 3) tenant override precedence rules. can sketch RFC by Tuesday.
kai: timeline SGTM. can you include a short simulation (10k synthetic requests) in the RFC showing reduced oscillation? helps prod folks.
sarah: will do.
ops-bot: Feature flag routing.tenant.123.cost_window changed to 10m by sarah at 2143500320
ops-bot: Feature flag routing.tenant.123.max_penalty changed to 0.35 by sarah at 2143500331
devin: after the flags we should watch weight crossing rate and fallback count for 30m. i'll set an alert rule to trigger if crossings > 3 in 15m.
maria: adding a note — if stability_boost is implemented make sure it respects region affinity constraints (we don't want to lock to a region during an actual outage). keep safety overrides.
kai: yep. thanks all. we'll reconvene after the RFC draft. :raised_hands:
